Introduction

SUNNYKEY is a South Korean girl project band under AMAJOR Entertainment. The members are Bada, Yena, Yulim, Eunsol, and Joohyeon. They were formed in March 2023 and made their debut on March 12, 2025, with their first single, "Shadow Dance".
